# Python-bloggers

> A community-driven blog aggregator curating Python data science news, tutorials, and technical posts from the global Python blogosphere.

Python-bloggers aggregates high-quality content from community bloggers focusing on data science, machine learning, and Python development. The platform serves as a central hub for discovering tutorials, best practices, and emerging trends in the Python ecosystem, with support for RSS feed submissions from contributors.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Data Science
- pandas
- Machine Learning
- Generative AI
- OpenAI
- R Programming
- Python Tutorials
- Data Analysis
- Blog Aggregation
- Python Community
- Data Protection
- AI Agents
- Python Packages
- LLMs

## Getting Started

- [Python-bloggers Homepage](https://python-bloggers.com): Main aggregation feed of Python data science news and tutorials from community bloggers
- [About Python-bloggers](https://python-bloggers.com/about): Learn about the Python-bloggers mission, community focus, and blog aggregator platform
- [Add Your Blog](https://python-bloggers.com/add-your-blog): Submit your Python and data science blog via RSS feed to reach the Python-bloggers community

## Data Science & Machine Learning

- [Create A Pandas Dataframe AI Agent With Generative AI, Python And OpenAI](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/12/create-a-pandas-dataframe-ai-agent-with-generative-ai-python-and-openai): Tutorial on building Pandas AI agents using LangChain, OpenAI and generative AI
- [Analyzing Paper Reviews with LLMs: ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Gemini, and Claude](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/12/analyzing-paper-reviews-with-llms-i-used-chatgpt-deepseek-qwen-mistral-gemini-and-claude-and-you-should-too-publish-the-analysis): Comparative analysis of LLM models for academic paper review evaluation and bias assessment
- [Data Science Quiz For Humanities](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/11/data-science-quiz-for-humanities): Interactive data science assessment using Python, R and pandas for humanities datasets

## Python Development & Packages

- [Creating a Python Package with Poetry for Beginners Part 3](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/12/creating-a-python-package-with-poetry-for-beginners-part-3): Beginner-friendly guide to Python package creation with Poetry and PyPI publishing
- [tisthemachinelearner: New Workflow with uv for R Integration of scikit-learn](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/12/tisthemachinelearner-new-workflow-with-uv-for-r-integration-of-scikit-learn): Guide on R-Python integration using uv package manager and scikit-learn workflows

## Data Privacy & Security

- [Python for Data Privacy VIDEO](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/11/python-for-data-privacy-video): Educational video on Python techniques for implementing data privacy and protection
- [Privacy of Continuous Data with Python](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/11/privacy-of-continous-data-with-python): Tutorial on data anonymization and binning continuous data using pandas and Python

## Career & Professional Development

- [The Differences Between Temporary and Permanent Work Permits for Tech Talent](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/11/the-differences-between-temporary-and-permanent-work-permits-for-tech-talent): Article on tech employment law covering temporary and permanent work permit distinctions
- [Start 2026 Ahead of the Curve: Boost Your Career with Jumping Rivers Training](https://python-bloggers.com/2025/11/start-2026-ahead-of-the-curve-boost-your-career-with-jumping-rivers-training): Overview of Jumping Rivers data science and Python training courses for professional development
